notes.title: The Multiverse Cleaner now available!
notes.content:
[h1]It's time![/h1]

After 2 and a half years of solo development, The Multiverse Cleaner has been officially released.

I'd like to thank my friends and family who have encouraged me in this development.  For me, it's a childhood dream to bring a game to the world.

[h2]A conspiracy to eradicate[/h2]

As a new cleaner, Ted finds himself caught up in a conspiracy orchestrated by a nymph named Phoebe.  It's up to you to stop Phoebe!

[hr][/hr]
